English

[edit]
English Wikipedia has an article on:
mortadella
Wikipedia

Etymology

[edit]

From Italian mortadella, from diminutive of Latin murtatum (“sausage seasoned with myrtle berries”), from myrtatum, from myrtus, from Ancient Greek μύρτος (múrtos).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • Rhymes: -ɛlə

Noun

[edit]

mortadella (countable and uncountable, plural mortadellas or mortadelle)

  1. A smooth-textured Italian pork sausage with lumps of fat, flavoured with spices; eaten cold.

Synonyms

[edit]
  • baloney
  • boloney
  • Bologna sausage
  • bologna

  • Galician: mortadela (gl) f
  • Georgian: მორტადელა (morṭadela)
  • German: Mortadella (de) f
  • Greek: μορταδέλα (el) f (mortadéla)
